title: Astronomers discover hidden alien planet in James Webb images
caption:
Astronomers have found a way to spot exoplanets that were previously invisible in James Webb Space Telescope data. By creating a 'digital twin' of the telescope, they can mathematically remove blinding starlight to reveal the faint worlds hiding behind it.

Source: Sciencedaily - Astronomers discover hidden alien planet in James Webb images

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108233028.htm
